newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH SHARES END DOWN 4.36 PCT AFTER VOLATILE DAY.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH SHARES END DOWN 4.36 PCT AFTER VOLATILE DAY.

text.p: 1438 GMT - Dutch shares end over four percent lower, one of their biggest ever one day falls, after a highly volatile session. AEX index slips at the open, following the Dow's 100-point fall on Tuesday. Decline accelerated by options-related selling ahead of Friday's expiries and by edginess ahead of key U.S. sales and prices data in the afternoon, dealers say. Market rallies after data proves benign -- from around four percent lower to near parity on the day, but falls back again as Wall Street turns lower and dollar wilts in the U.S. on hawkish Bundesbank inflation report.
* AEX closes down 42.64 points, 4.36 percent, at 935.76.
